title: Entrant demand for research inputs creates at most one incumbent-innovation hump
checked_scope: The source's unique research-input equilibrium for all λ≥0 with ψ>0, including χ≥0; comparison to ψ=0.
significance: Proves a global single-peak theorem and an exact initial-sign criterion, replacing local reversal examples by a full response-shape characterization.
